name: Wispook at the campfire
notes: Wispook on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 8) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 8 unlocked it takes seat 8. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 8: left, 9: down-left). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
